title: Archimedes Textures for Eureka Ships mod
description: Classic Archimedes textures to Eureka ships mod
body:
this resource pack brings classic 1.7.10 minecraft Archimedes ship textures to new modern Valkyrien Skies Eureka Ships

IMPORTANT NOTICE:TEXTURES GLITCH ALMOST EVERY TIME YOU APPLY A RESOURCE PACK WILE USING VALKYRIEN SKIES AND EUREKA,NO JUST GOING TO MAIN MENU IS NOT ENOUGH,TO FIX SHIP HELM FROM GLITCHING YOU NEED TO EXIT FROM THE GAME ENTIERLY,ONLY FULLY RELAUNCHING THE GAME CAN FIX THE SHIP HELM GLITCHING...

first few pictures did not have the engine changed because i didnt figure out why specifically changing the engine made the ship helm glitch out,i stil dont know why,but only way to fix it is fully relaunching the game

i own nothing,all thanks go to original creator of Archimedes for 1.7.10,all i did was simply port the old textures to Eureka for reliving the nostalgia
